recipes.name: Yoyo's BBQ Beans
ingredients_raw: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (28 ounce) can baked beans with pork

steps.text: Cook and stir the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until evenly browned; drain. Combine the onion and garlic in the skillet with the beef, and cook until the onion becomes transparent, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir the salt , pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and parsley into the beef mixture; cook 1 to 2 minutes.

Stir the canned beans into the beef mixture. Add the mustard, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, and barbecue sauce and stir until blended. Taste and season with additional salt and pepper, if desired. Lower heat to medium-low and simmer mixture for 30 minutes to thoroughly combine flavors.

raw_recipe.headline: Yoyo's BBQ Beans
raw_recipe.description: Use a shortcut--open a can of pork and beans--to make this zesty barbecued bean dish fast and easy. Seasonings for the ground beef, onions and beans mixture include mustard, brown sugar, garlic and onion powders, Worcestershire sauce, and barbecue sauce

review.reviewBody:
This was a big hit with the whole family. I followed the recipe as it was - except... I used Sweet Baby Ray's BBQ Sauce & only about 3/4 Cup, instead of 1 1/2 Cups.
Excellent!

Everyone should try this recipe!! Out of this world, and the best bean recipe I have ever eaten!!! AMAZING..I made few changes to it but used the rest of ingredient the same way. I used 2 lb Angus beef, and 1.5 {28 oz} Campbell Pork and Bean, I suggest to drain the liquid first before adding it to the beef if you want your recipe to be thicker & I used 15oz bottle of Sweet Sass BBQ sauce-garlic Fix from Busche"s market and it came out AMAZING I made it on Saturday one day before this Easter and on Easter day I put it in the crock pot an hour before serving on low and it thickened enough for me and everyone was raving and humming while they were eating it, so funny!! I am sooooo glad I found this recipe!! Thank you YoYo family for this delicious and rich recipe!!! I HIGHLY RECOMEDED!!!

Probably the best BBQ beans I've ever made, but I added another can of beans, it had a very strong bbq flavor to it, and I usually like a very strong flavor, but this was a little too much even for me.

This is the best baked beans recipe I have ever made. I have never taken this to a cook out and not had people rave about it. I have made it with hamburger, bacon, pulled pork, and combinations there of. Though I do make it on my smoker a lot. Showed recipe to a friend having superbowl party. The fallowing years party he had guest asking for him to make them. I really don't know what else to say but Thank You Jodi Hanlon for posting this.

Very good! I'd double the onion next time, because I love it and I think you almost can't have enough of them in baked beans :) My BBQ sauce and baked beans were both on the sweet side so I omitted the brown sugar and didn't miss it, though I'm sure that varies from brand to brand. Thanks for the recipe!

This was a tasty dish. My family loved it and asked for 2nds and 3rds. I did add hot peppers with the onions and 3 tsp of hot sause since my family likes spicy dishes. Thank You so much for the recipe Yo-Yo.

I only had a 14 oz can of beans and not enough bbq sauce, but the dish turned out very nicely anyway. My picky eater boys both devoured it, and hubby also enjoyed it. Not the prettiest dish, but delicious and family friendly.
great recipe, doubled up the recipe and made this dish on memorial day Bbq. No leftovers!!!! Everyone loved em!!!! thanks for the recipe.
Awesome, made it for a guys graduation party, it was a hit!
Awesome, made it for a guys graduation party, it was a hit!
I made up this recipe just this morning for an afternoon bbq. Easy and SO SO delicious! Thanks, Yoyo!
